facts.fact: removing an object leaves its mesh (and the mesh's material) in bpy.data with 0 users: an orphan
a Python reference to a removed object raises ReferenceError when touched
facts.error: ReferenceError: StructRNA of type Object has been removed

facts.fact: bpy.data.meshes.remove(mesh) on a mesh an object uses also deletes that object (objects without their obdata cannot exist)
bpy.data.orphans_purge() removes 0-user data; with do_recursive=False a material used only by an orphan mesh survives the first pass; do_recursive=True gets it
use_fake_user = True protects a 0-user datablock from purge (and from not being saved)
a 0-user datablock is not written when the file is saved
removing 2000 linked empties: a loop of objects.remove takes 0.17 s, bpy.data.batch_remove takes 0.006 s
a linked object's users count: 1 per collection it is in
